spec.name: Furniture Haunted Bookshelf
spec.description: A grounded gothic dark-oak bookshelf with a stepped crown, three book compartments, worn purple bindings, a small ivory skull and a translucent corner cobweb. Front faces negative Z. All geometry stays within the requested furniture bounds.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: gothic dark wood bookshelf with purple books, small skull and cobweb corner. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
